report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN TECHNICAL REPORT Whitehaven
how_pct_was_used: The PCT Go Dutch scenario outputs were used to validate identified desire lines and support the network planning process by comparing potential future cycling demand against the identified routes.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation framework was developed using criteria including Effectiveness, Alignment with policy objectives, Economic factors, and Deliverability issues.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has identified a priority cycling network of 18 routes and a priority walking network, with estimated delivery costs of £57 million and £16 million respectively, to be used as a basis for securing government funding and developer contributions.
pct_usage_quote: The link between Whitehaven and Bigrigg, consisting of Loop Road South and Egremont Road, appears to be the most popular route in all current and future scenarios in the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) (see www.pct.bike for further information on the PCT).
